The vehicle presents with damage to the left front quarter, including a cracked headlamp assembly, a deformed fender with a bent
support bracket, and scuffing along the bumper cover that continues onto the wheel arch. The forward radiator support shows a
slight shift, though it is not fully clear whether every mark seen here resulted from this impact, and a closer teardown may help
separate the old from the new. The proposed plan replaces the headlamp and fender, straightens the bracket, and refinishes the
affected panels. Labor hours are consistent with the damage described. The repair billing shows no repeated charges, and no prior
damage to this vehicle is known to the appraiser.
